source: These symbols can be found in real Aztec iconography, like in the 137 restored illustrations below.
why: This is a record count (the number of restored god illustrations, repeated as “around 137 gods” in the work-in-progress note), a description of the dataset rather than a finding derived from it.

source: Be sure to seek out the 13 major Gods
why: The bare count of 13 major gods is a description of a category in the dataset, not a finding; the 13 major gods are used as a subgroup in the multiple-category fact instead.

source: most are both creative and destructive, spiritual and material
why: Read as two pairwise overlaps, the data does not support “most”: 30 of the 137 gods carry both life and death and 12 carry both spiritual expansion and material expansion. The reproduced fact uses the broader pattern that a majority carry more than one of the four thematic categories.

source: Spoken since the 7th century, today it’s the second most common language in the country, with around 2M speakers, mostly in rural areas.
